tasks.label: Runner: Save Map
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source "$HOME/runner_ws/install/setup.bash"; NAME="${input:mapSaveName}"; if [[ ! "$NAME" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]; then echo "Invalid map name. Use only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens." >&2; exit 1; fi; MAP="$HOME/runner_ws/maps/$NAME"; mkdir -p "$HOME/runner_ws/maps"; if compgen -G "${MAP}.*" >/dev/null; then echo "Refusing to overwrite existing map artifacts: ${MAP}.*" >&2; ls -lh "${MAP}."*; exit 1; fi; echo "Saving posegraph to $MAP"; ros2 service call /slam_toolbox/serialize_map slam_toolbox/srv/SerializePoseGraph "{filename: \"$MAP\"}"; echo "Saving occupancy grid to $MAP"; ros2 service call /slam_toolbox/save_map slam_toolbox/srv/SaveMap "{name: {data: \"$MAP\"}}"; echo; echo "Saved map artifacts:"; ls -lh "${MAP}."*'

tasks.label: Runner: Record Rosbag
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source "$HOME/runner_ws/install/setup.bash"; set -eo pipefail; NAME="${input:rosbagName}"; if [[ ! "$NAME" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]; then echo "Invalid bag name. Use only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens." >&2; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/runner_ws/bags"; OUTPUT="$HOME/runner_ws/bags/${NAME}_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"; echo "Recording all topics to:"; echo "$OUTPUT"; echo "Stop with Ctrl+C to finalize the bag."; exec ros2 bag record --storage mcap --all-topics --output "$OUTPUT"'

tasks.label: Stop all launches
tasks.command: pkill -INT -f 'ros2 launch runner_bringup' ; pkill -INT -f motor_node ; sleep 1 ; sudo systemctl restart runner-pwm-setup.service || true

inputs.description: New map name, without a path or extension
